subject: Evidence request: SDLC artifacts and CI gating clarifications for LumenBank
messages:
From: Anya Petrova <security@lumenbank.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: LumenBank Procurement <procure@lumenbank.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: SDLC artifacts and CI gating clarifications

Tessa —

Thanks for the intro. As part of our intake for vendor security assessment (SIG + SOC 2 preparation), we need a compact set of SDLC artifacts to verify your engineering controls. Could you provide the following by EOD Friday if possible?

- Code review sampling: PR IDs + links for a 30-day sample (we will spot-check diffs)
- CI/CD build logs for representative pipelines (prefer last two weeks)
- Evidence of PR gating (policy/rules and a sample enforcement event)
- Secrets management: rotation cadence notes, keystore handling, any short-lived token sampling
- Change management: change approvals for production-impacting releases in Q4 2026

We prefer a single index file listing artifacts and short instructions for any redacted items. If some items need an NDA/portal, flag that and we can route procurement.

Anya Petrova
Senior Information Security Analyst
LumenBank
security@lumenbank.com

(P.S. we will accept redacted logs, but please annotate redactions where possible)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Anya Petrova <security@lumenbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, LumenBank Procurement <procure@lumenbank.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SDLC artifacts and CI gating clarifications

Hi Anya —

Thanks for the clear list. We're happy to provide these. I'm looping in Marissa (Platform Security) and Jonas (Engineering Ops) to assemble a compact evidence package and an index.

Plan: Marissa will prepare the code-review samples, PR gating screenshots, and a short write-up on reviewer enforcement; Jonas will pull CI build logs and keystore/rotation notes. We'll produce: index CSV, redacted CI logs (zipped), PR gating policy + sample PDF, and short notes on change approvals.

Can we aim to share an initial package by Thursday EOD PST, and a follow-up with additional logs and Drive links by Friday? If you need an encrypted transfer method or DocuSign NDA first, let us know — procurement is cc'd.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123

Anya / team —

Attached is an initial evidence bundle and an index: sdlc-evidence-index.csv (attached), pr-gating-sample.pdf (attached). The index maps each artifact to a short description and any redaction notes. Highlights:

- Code review sampling: 12 PRs from 2027-02-01 to 2027-02-28, links included (org/repo/PR#). Each sampled PR includes reviewer names and minimal diffs; any customer data removed and flagged in index.
- PR gating policy: enforcement is via branch protection + OPA policy in CI; the sample event (PR #2174) shows a failed merge due to missing approvals (screenshot in PDF).
- Change approvals: summary table with approval chain for three Q4 2026 releases included in index.

Attachments: sdlc-evidence-index.csv (index), pr-gating-sample.pdf (policy + enforcement screenshot). I am keeping CI build logs and keystore rotation notes in the secure bucket — Jonas will attach the redacted logs and rotation notes in follow-up.

Attachments: sdlc-evidence-index.csv (text/csv), pr-gating-sample.pdf (application/pdf)

Marissa Cole

Subject: RE: Evidence request: SDLC artifacts and CI gating clarifications

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. Quick clarifications before we review the attachments:

1) For the CI build logs, can you confirm whether build agents use ephemeral credentials (short-lived tokens) or long-lived service keys? If short-lived, please provide a sample token rotation event.
2) For change approvals, we need the timestamped approval records where possible (GitHub PR approval + ticketing reference). If certain approvals are in internal dashboards, a screenshot with metadata is OK.

If you prefer, we can take the initial index and then request a targeted second pass for anything we deem missing.

Anya

Anya —

Following up with the CI and secrets pieces. Per Marissa's index, attached are: ci-build-logs-2027-02.zip (redacted build logs from linux-build and canary pipelines), keystore-rotation-notes.pdf (rotation schedule and sample audit event), and a short changelog slice with PR approval timestamps. Links: secure Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleLink (read-only; link expires 30 days).

Notes on your questions:
- Build agents run using ephemeral tokens minted by our instance metadata service. We rotate the service principal monthly; samples of a rotation event are in keystore-rotation-notes.pdf (page 3 shows a rotation log entry timestamped 2027-02-12T02:14:03Z).
- PR approvals: we include GitHub approval timestamps and the associated ticket ID (JIRA ticket: ENGOPS-1127) in the changelog slice attached.

If you want fuller logs or longer retention exports, let us know which scopes and we can arrange a secured S3 transfer. We can also generate a redacted audit trail CSV if that helps review automation.

Attachments: ci-build-logs-2027-02.zip (application/zip), keystore-rotation-notes.pdf (application/pdf), sdlc-evidence-index.csv (text/csv)

Regards,

Jonas Weber
Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com
